access_limits: The 382,229-row prepared artifact and eleven selected captures are this project's local preparation counts, not claimed whole-release counts from the article.

support_scope: Dataset identity, creators, repository and registered year. Source identity must remain distinct from local file qualification.
locator: DataCite DOI metadata; author-hosted source record.
access_limits: DataCite JSON retrieved successfully through Python; DataPort landing page blocked automated access. No author checksum was available to authenticate the locally acquired attributed file.

apa: Shadabfar, H., Dehghan, M., & Sadeghian, B. (2025). DSRL-APT-2023: A new synthetic dataset for advanced persistent threats. ISeCure, 17(2), 107–116. https://doi.org/10.22042/isecure.2025.214212
publication_status: Peer-reviewed journal article, July 2025 issue; front matter identifies an earlier ISCISC 2024 presentation.
support_scope: DSRL attacks are generated from DAPT2020 using CTGAN/CopulaGAN and benign rows sampled from DAPT2020. It is not an independent observed-campaign replication of DAPT.
locator: Section 5, printed p. 112 (PDF page 6), and article front matter.
access_limits: Primary PDF read directly. Five thousand generated records per attack type does not imply equal stage counts; generated timestamps do not establish a physical execution clock.

apa: Tijjani, S. I., Ghita, B., Clarke, N., & Craven, M. (2026). S-DAPT-2026: A stage-aware synthetic dataset for advanced persistent threat detection (Version 2) [Withdrawn preprint]. arXiv. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2601.06690
publication_status: Submitted January 10, 2026; withdrawn April 1, 2026. Record reports analysis errors affecting conclusions.
support_scope: Documents release/publication-status uncertainty in the requested dataset intake. It is not evidence supporting detector performance.
locator: arXiv withdrawal notice and version history.
access_limits: A later SSRN listing exists for S-DAPT-2026: A stage-aware synthetic dataset framework for advanced persistent threat detection (DOI 10.2139/ssrn.6603942). Its full text/download was inaccessible, and this review did not verify a corrected qualified data release. This is an access limit, not a claim that none exists.
